# SARKAR / VOLT — Independent Luxury Fragrance Concept

> SARKAR / VOLT is an independent fictional luxury fragrance brand concept developed as an academic and creative design portfolio project. It explores modern haute perfumerie branding, King Chess crystal flacon packaging sculpture, and 0ms-blocking digital web experiences. SARKAR / VOLT is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any existing commercial fragrance brand or public figure.

## Conceptual Specifications (Design Targets)

- Project: SARKAR / VOLT
- Classification: Independent Academic & Creative Portfolio Design Study
- Featured Concept: VOLT Eau De Parfum
- Flacon Sculpture: Bespoke King Chess piece in cobalt-blue crystal glass with weighted metallic crown cap
- Conceptual Concentration: 25% Pure Extrait Target
- Theoretical Longevity: 12+ hours skin aura
- Fragrance Family: Electric Woody Citrus Extrait

## Conceptual Olfactory Pyramid

- Act 01 (Top Accord): Calabrian Bergamot, Sun-Drenched Black Pepper
- Act 02 (Heart Accord): Crushed Violet Leaves, Metallic Ozonic Accord
- Act 03 (Base Accord): Smoky Haitian Vetiver, Warm Amber, Velvet Musk

## Front-End Web Architecture

- Framework: Pure Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript (Zero framework bloat)
- Performance: 100% inlined critical CSS, 0ms render blocking, asynchronous font loading
- Core Web Vitals: LCP < 1.5s, CLS 0.00, TBT < 50ms
- Interactive Modules: Three-wave requestIdleCallback execution for HTML5 Canvas atmosphere, 3D bottle tilt, and longevity simulation
